from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, shutil
p=Path('reports/20261102-progressive-history-2')
shutil.copyfile(p/'REPORT.md',p/'REPORT-WASM-FIRST-ATTEMPT.md')
plan=p/'affected-plan.json'
plan.write_text(json.dumps(json.loads(plan.read_text()),separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
logs={}
for f in list(p.glob('*.log')):
 data=f.read_bytes(); lines=data.splitlines(keepends=True)
 parts=[]
 if len(lines)>=1500:
  for start in range(0,len(lines),1000):
   part=f.with_name(f.stem+f'.part-{start//1000+1:02}.log'); part.write_bytes(b''.join(lines[start:start+1000])); parts.append(part.name)
  assert b''.join((p/name).read_bytes() for name in parts)==data
  f.unlink()
 else: parts=[f.name]
 summaries=[line for line in data.decode().splitlines() if line.startswith(('# tests ', '# pass ', '# fail ', '# cancelled ', '# skipped ', '# duration_ms ', 'ref-check:', '# 32 commands', 'Checked ', 'STOP:', '$ tsc', 'Error: guide', 'guide api ')) or 'Finished `dev`' in line]
 logs[f.name]={'parts':parts,'lines':len(lines),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'summaries':summaries}
(p/'LOGS.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs,indent=2)+'\n')
for name in ['progressive-verified.log','acquisition-2.log','history-start-2.log','start-order-final.log','typecheck-verified.log','ref-check.log','affected.log']:
 print(name+'\n'+'\n'.join(logs[name]['summaries']))
print('Evidence packaging: long logs split losslessly; plan JSON compacted; first-attempt report preserved.')
